comment: Where every test of today's three suites, and every behaviour docs/*.md and README.md describe, is covered in the rebuild. tools/check-contracts.py extracts the tests from macos/BromeliaTests, windows/tests and linux/tests, and checks that each one is here, that everything it points to exists, and writes COVERAGE.md from this file. A test is covered by the fixtures and scenarios whose `from` names it, by `covers` below, and through `same` by the tests it does the same as. Items: scenario:<id>, fixture:<path in shared/fixtures>[#<case id>], schema:<path in shared/schema>[#<key>], ci:<check>.

ci.windows-screenshots: Snapshots.cs in the Windows job (phase 4: UI tests against bromeliad with fakes)

changes.what: Only one engine runs per user; automation.lock and its one-minute takeover are gone.

Unfinished jobs aren't written to unfinished-<pid>.json and turned into history records: jobs are in the database from creation, and RecoveryService requeues, resumes or interrupts them after a restart. An interrupted rip's staging is kept (hidden, listed with the job) instead of being renamed to a visible 'INCOMPLETE - <id>' folder.

Files that aren't a finished archive go to <library>/_Quarantine/<name> [READ ERRORS] or [INCOMPLETE] instead of a sibling '<folder> [INCOMPLETE]' or an 'INCOMPLETE - <job8>' subfolder of a shared folder.
Staging is <library>/.bromelia/staging/<job>/ (same filesystem, so the commit is a rename) instead of <output folder>/.bromelia-incomplete-<job8>.

The archive record is bromelia-<unit8>.json (version 3) and the logs bromelia-<unit8>-log.txt, makemkv-<unit8>-log.txt, makemkv-<unit8>-debug-log.txt, instead of bromelia.json, bromelia (2).json, bromelia-log.txt …; version 2 records are still read.
A failed post-processing step marked affectsOutcome (was failJobOnError) makes the outcome succeededStepsFailed instead of failed: the archive stays committed.
A disc archived before, in an automatic rip, ends as skipped (was cancelled); with alreadyArchived ask the job waits for an answer instead of stopping.
No library root is ever created; a library needs its .bromelia-library marker, and jobs wait (blocked) while it is missing. Today the output root is created on demand.

The API is /v1/… with codes in error bodies; tokens are accepted as Bearer or a login cookie, never in the URL (?token= is gone); scoped read tokens; an Origin check. The web page's /api/status, /api/drives/<lane>/… and /api/settings/<id>/set are replaced by EngineAPI routes and updateConfig.
Engine messages are codes with parameters (shared/messages); clients render them. Today's English sentences become en.json texts.
An automatic rip's countdown happens before the job exists; cancelling it creates no job (today a waiting job is created and then cancelled into the history).
Setting up an unconfigured drive no longer copies the default drive configuration: a drive entry points at a profile (the default one unless chosen).
Presets and the Archive everything preset are profiles; plugins are steps plus rules; conflictPolicy overwrite is called merge (it never overwrote a file).
Secrets (registration key, API keys, web tokens, notification URLs) are no longer stored in config.json but in the keystore; config.json is written 0600.
The engine host is its own executable (bromeliad) on every platform; macOS's launch agent runs it (Label app.bromelia.engine) instead of 'Bromelia --headless'.
